name: Sling
description: For those with little interest in meeting their foe's blade. Go forth, and split them like autumn leaves.

abilities.name: Good Arm
abilities.description: May attack using Might instead of Grace with ranged weapons.

abilities.name: Long Shot
abilities.description: Range can be increased up to twice original range. Each extra square gives -1 die penalty.

abilities.name: Rebound
abilities.description: Once per round, if ranged attack is dodged/parried, it ricochets to adjacent target. Empty squares can be targeted to ricochet.

abilities.name: Bullseye
abilities.description: 6s on ranged attacks count as 2 successes.
